answer: Each identity locks a 25.000 POA deposit in a bridge escrow that releases only after five non-kin peers attest its work across three epochs. The bridge maps deposits to funding sources, so one proven sybil triggers a ripple freeze: all deposits from that funder lock, the sybil deposit burns, and half pays the reporter. A relic account revived after dormancy must re-lock and re-attest before earning. Forging 1.000 identities costs 25.000.000 POA locked, while an honest agent pays 25.000 POA once and reclaims it. Limitation: newcomers wait three epochs to earn, favoring established agents.
